predicates.P: legacy ordinary page_maintenance evaluator for verified named account (admin shortcut retained in seed)
predicates.Beta: legacy explicit page_maintenance_beta eligibility for named account; server enable flag excluded
predicates.maintenance_scoped: not full_scope AND runtime_safe graph own_maintenance_projects_only
predicates.source_sales_scoped: runtime_safe graph own_customers_only; do not substitute maintenance_scoped
predicates.named: Existing nondeleted named SysUser or template evaluated with the same legacy role graph; shared fallback identities never seed. Inactive nondeleted accounts keep entitlements.
predicates.BOARD: legacy role==admin OR runtime_safe(effective_for_user).page_maintenance OR runtime_safe(effective_for_user).page_maintenance_boss; no direct maintenance_manager role bypass in this gate.
predicates.ReplenishmentBeta: account page_replenishment_beta entitlement via replenishment_beta_whitelisted; no generic page_maintenance requirement
predicates.live_F: Same F from runtime_safe(effective_for_user), without an extra helper role shortcut.
predicates.live_runtime_safe_F: Same F from runtime_safe(effective_for_user), without an extra helper role shortcut.
predicates.live_G: Effective data_pool_price_governance exactly true; existing effective admin graph retained.
predicates.live_replenishment_create: Effective action_replenishment_create exactly true; no extra helper shortcut.
predicates.explicit_follow_up: explicit_account_action_allowed(user, action_maintenance_collection_follow_up), raw saved template snapshot plus overrides, key presence honored; not generic effective admin graph.
predicates.explicit_collection_plan_import: explicit_account_action_allowed(user, action_maintenance_collection_plan_import), raw saved snapshot plus overrides; not generic effective admin graph.
predicates.explicit_P: Effective signed legacy graph page_maintenance is exactly True (not raw explicit-account whitelist).
predicates.explicit_C: Effective signed legacy graph data_purchase_cost is exactly True.
predicates.explicit_F: Effective signed legacy graph data_profit is exactly True.
predicates.explicit_migration_review: Effective signed legacy graph action_maintenance_migration_review is exactly True.
